title: Clean text with Cow
description:
Return borrowed text when nothing changes and owned text only when it must.

```
"hello world"   -> borrowed: "hello world"
"hello  world"  -> owned:    "hello world"
"tab\there"     -> owned:    "tab here"
```
hints: First check whether any change is needed: a char that is whitespace but not `' '`, or two spaces in a row. If not, return `Cow::Borrowed(s)` (lesson 7.02).
`Cow::Owned(s.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" "))` builds the tidy copy. `matches!(c, Cow::Borrowed(_))` tells which one you have.
requirements: `fn tidy(s: &str) -> Cow<'_, str>` collapses runs of whitespace into one space.
When the text is already tidy, return `Cow::Borrowed` without allocating.
stretch: Write `fn escape_html(s: &str) -> Cow<'_, str>` the same way.
